SELECT s.region, s.store_id>=900 AS pseudo, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) calc, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date<s.valid_from OR f.sale_date>s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outside, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH x AS (SELECT *, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) AS local_date FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-30' AND '2024-10-02')
SELECT 'dups' k, count(*) a, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) b, 0 c FROM x WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'date_mismatch_local', count(*), sum(CASE WHEN local_date<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 FROM x
UNION ALL SELECT 'date_mismatch_utc', count(*), sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 FROM x
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_overlap', count(*), (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30'), (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30') FROM x WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_or_odd', sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL OR net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM x

calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_end_date >= '2024-07-01' AND period_start_date <= '2024-10-31' ORDER BY 3

SELECT w.status, w.fulfilment_type, count(DISTINCT w.web_order_id) orders, count(*) lines, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-08-31' THEN f.gross_amount END) aug
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, CASE WHEN f.sale_date<'2024-09-01' THEN 'Aug' ELSE 'Sep' END m, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(round(f.gross_amount/nullif(f.net_amount,0),4)) lo, max(round(f.gross_amount/nullif(f.net_amount,0),4)) hi
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3,2

calls.statement:
SELECT s.region,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024_gross_sales,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024_gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id <> 999
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY CASE s.region WHEN 'North' THEN 1 WHEN 'South' THEN 2 WHEN 'East' THEN 3 WHEN 'West' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
